quote: The class was absolutely amazing. We learned traditional recipes and they were all so tasty. I loved that everything was done by hand.
author: Alexa B.

quote: We had the most amazing time making coffee in a beautiful setting. The host was incredibly friendly and made the experience one to remember.
author: Karen S.

quote: 100% recommend giving this place a visit. The instructor took us through all the steps patiently and the coffees were wonderful.
author: Bethany

quote: A beautiful morning activity in Da Nang. The phin coffee lesson was clear, relaxed, and delicious.
author: Maya L.

quote: The egg coffee was my favorite. I finally understand how much technique goes into one small cup.
author: Daniel R.

quote: Friendly host, cozy space, and very hands-on. It felt personal from start to finish.
author: Sophie M.

quote: I joined with my family and everyone had fun. The instructor made each step easy to follow.
author: Hiro T.

quote: A calm, authentic experience away from the busy tourist spots. Highly recommended.
author: Elena G.

quote: The salted coffee surprised me the most. Sweet, creamy, and balanced perfectly.
author: Noah K.

quote: Great value and a memorable way to learn about Vietnamese coffee culture.
author: Priya S.

quote: The class was relaxed but still very informative. I left with recipes I can make at home.
author: Liam C.

quote: Small group size made it easy to ask questions and get help with each drink.
author: Grace W.

quote: I loved the coconut coffee. It was refreshing, creamy, and fun to prepare.
author: Nina P.

quote: The host explained the history behind each drink, not just the recipe. That made it special.
author: Tom H.

quote: A perfect activity for coffee lovers. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming.
author: Amelia J.

quote: Clear instruction, tasty coffee, and a very photogenic setting. I would do it again.
author: Lucas F.

quote: The class felt authentic and local. I learned more than I expected in 90 minutes.
author: Chloe D.

quote: Everything was prepared thoughtfully. The ingredients were fresh and the class was well organized.
author: Mark A.

quote: We booked a private group and it was smooth, flexible, and very enjoyable.
author: Rachel N.

quote: A lovely host and delicious drinks. The egg coffee cream was incredible.
author: Yuki S.

quote: The pace was just right. We had enough time to make, taste, and ask questions.
author: Oliver B.

quote: This was one of our favorite experiences in Vietnam. Simple, warm, and memorable.
author: Marta V.

quote: I appreciated the small details, from the beans to the way the phin was explained.
author: Ethan P.

quote: The instructor was patient and kind. Even beginners can enjoy this class.
author: Hannah Z.

quote: A must-do in Da Nang if you enjoy coffee. The salted cream was unforgettable.
author: Mei L.

quote: The workshop was cozy and personal. It felt like visiting a local friend.
author: Jonas E.

quote: Loved learning the traditional method without machines. It made the coffee feel more meaningful.
author: Isabelle R.

quote: Great for couples and friends. We laughed a lot and drank a lot of coffee.
author: Ben T.

quote: The class was well worth booking ahead. Everything felt smooth and personal.
author: Sara K.

quote: Beautiful experience, wonderful coffee, and a very welcoming teacher.
author: Anna M.
